newsitem.title: DUBAI: Egyptian official accuses Iran in Mubarak plot.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian official accuses Iran in Mubarak plot.

text.p: A senior Egyptian official has accused Iran for the first time of involvement in the assassination attempt on President Hosni Mubarak in Ethiopia last year, the Qatar News Agency (QNA) reported on Thursday.
"An Egyptian terrorist group carried out this attempt with the help of the Sudanese and also Iranian governments," Osama el-Baz, senior political adviser to Mubarak, told QNA.
Egypt has accused Sudan of helping the gunmen who tried to kill Mubarak in Addis Ababa in June 1995. Sudan denies this.
El-Baz's remarks marked the first time an Egyptian official has accused Iran of involvement in the assassination attempt.

Egypt, locked in a low-level guerrilla war with Moslem militants seeking to oust Mubarak and impose an Islamic state, has often accused Iran of trying to export its 1979 Islamic revolution to other regional states. Iran has denied the charge.
El-Baz had said earlier that relations with Iran could not improve until Tehran stopped "supporting terrorists".
